claim_label: AI: Predictable Engineering Tool vs. Autonomous Extractive Agent
description: This conflict centers on whether artificial intelligence should be categorized as a standard, testable engineering tool or an opaque, autonomous agent designed to circumvent human oversight for corporate gain.

instances.assertion: AI is an observable technology subject to standard engineering and adversarial testing.
AI is an autonomous agent used to bypass human oversight and maximize extractive corporate efficiency.
